comparisons.name: top-highlight-light
comparisons.description: The top edge of the App Store window, which has no title bar, over its sidebar, Aqua: 60 by 10 pt, 100 pt from the window's left. The two highlight rows of topHighlight under the inner rim (#f5f6f6 and #ecedee in the capture) over the sidebar's fill.

comparisons.name: top-highlight-rows-light
comparisons.description: The two highlight rows of topHighlight, Aqua, held one device pixel at a time at 2x, where each is drawn apart (at 1x a row of half a point is not). Same example as top-highlight-light. Expected colours are computed from the tokens over the sidebar's opaque fill #e7e8e8: the second row is --mac-window-top-highlight-second (white at 27%); the first adds --mac-window-top-highlight (white at 44%) and the Aqua inner rim (white at 16%). They are within 2 levels of the capture's #f5f6f6 and #ecedee.

pixels.note: first device row: the fill under both highlight layers and the rim, computed (capture #f5f6f6, measured)
second device row: the fill under the second layer only, computed (capture #ecedee, measured)
third device row: the sidebar's fill, --mac-material-sidebar-opaque; there are two rows and no more
the sidebar's fill below the edge, at both scales: the rows lie over the content and leave the rest of it as it is

comparisons.name: top-highlight-dark
comparisons.description: The top edge of the App Store window over its sidebar, Dark Aqua: the two highlight rows under the 1 pt inner rim (#777879 and #666769 in the capture) over the sidebar's fill.
